content.title: Development Services in Woodinville
content.summary: The Development Services Department in Woodinville oversees programs that ensure the city remains a great place to live, work, and grow. Services include pre-development, permitting, permit review, inspections, fire review, long-range planning, sign code regulations, special event permitting, code enforcement, and environmental protection.

steps.title: Access Permit Portal
steps.text: Permit applications and payments can be applied for online by visiting the online Permit Portal.

steps.title: Contact Permit Center
steps.text: If you have questions about a permit, please call or email the permit center at permitcenter@woodinvillewa.gov.
